cad8e17e61e582.s: Under the ECI's new measures for the 2026 Assembly elections, the maximum number of voters per polling station is:
cad8e17e61e582.x: CEC Gyanesh Kumar's measures capped a polling station at 1,200 voters and put colour photographs of candidates on EVMs.

n6d565698438.s: C. Joseph Vijay became the first non-DMK/AIADMK Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu since:
n6d565698438.x: Vijay (TVK), sworn in on 10 May 2026, is the first non-DMK/AIADMK Chief Minister since 1967, ending a ~60-year duopoly.

cab2bd5114fd2a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 'Women and Men in India' report?
o: Its 2025 edition records gender parity from primary to higher secondary level.
cab2bd5114fd2a.x: The report was first published in 1995, not 2005. Its 2025 (27th) edition, released by MoSPI, records gender parity from primary to higher secondary level.

caa6dd5452dc0c.s: As per 'Women and Men in India 2025', women's GER in higher education rose from 28.5 to:
caa6dd5452dc0c.x: Women's GER in higher education rose from 28.5 (2021-22) to 30.2 (2022-23); 37.5% to 45.9% is rural women's LFPR.

ne892817fde5.s: The Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 on One Nation One Election amends which Articles?
ne892817fde5.x: The Bill inserts Article 82A and amends Articles 83 and 172, not 330 and 332; it is with the JPC.

n0e78329f56b.s: How many star campaigners can a Registered Unrecognised Political Party (RUPP) have?
n0e78329f56b.x: RUPPs can have 20 star campaigners and get tax exemption under Section 12 of the Income Tax Act, 2025.

n41ff0c3078f.s: How many members does the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) have?
n41ff0c3078f.x: The IBBI has 10 members; the IBC received Presidential assent in May 2016, not December.

n3cf626b1bc4.s: How many of Andhra Pradesh's 875 judicial posts were reported vacant?
n3cf626b1bc4.x: Only 137 of the 875 judicial posts are vacant, far less than half.

n445dac44b7c.s: How many districts has Andhra Pradesh had since December 2025?
n445dac44b7c.x: Andhra Pradesh has 28 districts since December 2025; it had 26 from April 2022.

ca64236c6c1cb9.s: After the RBI's 7 October 2026 policy, the Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) rate is:
ca64236c6c1cb9.x: MSF/Bank Rate is 5.75%, with the repo rate at 5.50% and the SDF at 5.25%.

ca6667eeca22f2.s: On 7 October 2026, the RBI changed its policy stance from 'Neutral' to:
ca6667eeca22f2.x: The unanimous MPC decision, chaired by Governor Sanjay Malhotra, changed the stance to Calibrated Tightening.

ca5a622caa0ec7.s: The IMF's October 2026 WEO raised India's FY 2026-27 growth projection from 6.4% to:
ca5a622caa0ec7.x: The IMF raised it from 6.4% to 7.0%, citing domestic demand and services; 7.1% is the World Bank's figure.

ca0aa8e1f0fef6.s: In which year were the IMF's Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) introduced?
ca0aa8e1f0fef6.x: SDRs were introduced in 1969; the IMF originated at Bretton Woods in 1944 and began operations in 1947.

ca3034643815a3.s: The new national accounts series replaced which earlier base year?
ca3034643815a3.x: The new series uses 2022-23 as the base year, replacing 2011-12.

cae636249945d8.s: The Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Rules were issued in:
cae636249945d8.x: The DPDP Act was enacted in 2023 and the DPDP Rules were issued in 2025.

ca00501a318105.s: What share of India's trade by value is carried by sea?
ca00501a318105.x: Maritime trade carries about 95% of India's trade by value (about 70% by volume).

ca190561b4a30c.s: In the RBI's September 2026 report, India's rank in foreign-exchange reserves was:
ca190561b4a30c.x: India ranked fourth, after China, Japan and Switzerland, overtaking Russia.

ca3b6ce64a1939.s: Who is the MD and CEO of the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)?
ca3b6ce64a1939.x: Dilip Asbe heads NPCI, set up in 2008 in Mumbai. Malhotra is RBI Governor, Setty SBI Chairman, Pandey SEBI Chairman.

ca5280a4a9fb4d.s: India has film co-production treaties with how many countries?
ca5280a4a9fb4d.x: India has co-production treaties with 17 countries; India Cine Hub is the core platform of the Live Events Development Cell.

cac9529b802692.s: Under the Decentralised Grain Storage Plan, micro food-processing units are supported through:
cac9529b802692.x: Micro food-processing units come under PMFME; AIF gives financing and 3% interest subvention.

ca472920d48deb.s: Besides MSMEs and non-MSMEs, ECLGS 5.0 also covers:
ca472920d48deb.x: ECLGS 5.0 addresses external disruptions for MSMEs, non-MSMEs and airlines; Phase 4.0 covered hospitals and oxygen facilities.

cacc4b9a866c15.s: NETC FASTag, AePS and NFS are systems run by:
cacc4b9a866c15.x: NPCI runs UPI, RuPay, IMPS and NACH as well as AePS, APBS, NFS and NETC FASTag.

ca9fa64a65dc09.s: The GIS platform of the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan connects how many Central Ministries?
ca9fa64a65dc09.x: It connects 58 Central Ministries and all 36 States/UTs; it was launched on 13 October 2021.

ca56e927759344.s: India remains a net importer of pulses, importing about how much a year?
ca56e927759344.x: India imports about 60 lakh tonnes of pulses a year and ranks first in production, consumption and import.

ca475ae960acea.s: Offences, prosecution and arrest under GST are dealt with under the:
ca475ae960acea.x: These provisions are in the CGST Act, 2017; GST is destination-based.

ca7fa30885495e.s: India Cine Hub, offering foreign productions up to 40% of qualifying spend, is managed by:
o: Film and Television Institute of India
ca7fa30885495e.x: India Cine Hub is run by the NFDC (set up 1975) and offers incentives of up to 40% of qualifying spend.

cn89f579c1c2f3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2026-27 Kharif season area data (18 October 2026)?
o: Paddy area fell by 15.56 lakh hectares.
Odisha recorded a marginal rise in paddy area.
Area under pulses fell by 2.57 lakh hectares.
Telangana recorded the biggest fall in paddy area.
cn89f579c1c2f3.x: Area under pulses rose, not fell, by 2.57 lakh hectares; the other statements are correct.

cn1ac5e36276c9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Q2 2026-27 GDP estimate in the Finance Ministry's Monthly Economic Review?
o: Real GDP growth was estimated at 7.3%.
It came from a nowcasting model.
The model was first presented in the Economic Survey 2026.
Growth was driven mainly by exports.
cn1ac5e36276c9.x: Growth was driven by domestic demand and investment, not exports.

cn1ce5b26830a6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the GST Standing Committee formed in October 2026?
o: Kerala is one of its permanent members.
It has 5 large, 4 medium and 3 small States.
Seven of its seats rotate every two years.
Tamil Nadu is one of its permanent members.
cn1ce5b26830a6.x: The permanent members are Karnataka, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat and Tamil Nadu; Kerala is not one.

cne8963ed0ac94.s: BMI (Business Monitor International), which revised India's growth forecast in October 2026, is a division of:
cne8963ed0ac94.x: BMI is a division of Fitch Solutions; it named crude oil prices and El Nino as risks to India's growth.

cn288a32a97886.s: India's largest phenol-acetone facility at Haldia is the first phenol plant on India's:
cn288a32a97886.x: The Haldia plant is the first phenol plant on India's eastern coast, not the western coast.

cn21a1d1a8198d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the RBI Greenfield Data Centre at Jatni?
o: Its foundation was laid on 22 March 2023 by Shaktikanta Das.
It backs up RBI's main data centre in Chennai.
cn21a1d1a8198d.x: RBI's main data centre is in Navi Mumbai, not Chennai.

cn0e9fe442b035.s: Who was the Governor of Odisha at the inauguration of the RBI Greenfield Data Centre on 25 October 2026?
cn0e9fe442b035.x: Braj Mohan Ram is the Odisha Governor; Mohan Charan Majhi is the Chief Minister.

cn8f06209b894f.s: In SCOMET, the letter 'S' stands for:
cn8f06209b894f.x: SCOMET stands for Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies.

cna7405a245a2b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the State Bank of India?
o: It was established on 1 July 1955 under the SBI Act, 1955.
It was formed after nationalising the Imperial Bank of India.
It is headquartered in New Delhi.
cna7405a245a2b.x: SBI is headquartered in Mumbai; the other statements are correct.

cnbfc27a3337e4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about GST collections in October 2026?
o: Gross GST collection grew 22.9% year on year.
Gross GST collection was ₹2.31 lakh crore.
cnbfc27a3337e4.x: Net GST grew 25.6%; 15.8% was the growth in domestic GST.

cn0d05bffa4077.s: RBI's main data centre, for which the Jatni (Odisha) centre is the disaster-recovery backup, is in:
cn0d05bffa4077.x: The Jatni, Khordha centre backs up RBI's main data centre in Navi Mumbai.

new.s: In the 2026 Assembly elections, Tamil Nadu went to the polls on:
new.x: Tamil Nadu polled on 23 April 2026, with West Bengal's first phase; Assam, Kerala and Puducherry polled on 9 April.

new.s: In the 2026 Kerala Assembly election, the UDF won how many of the 140 seats?
new.x: The UDF won 102 of 140 seats in Kerala, ending 10 years of LDF rule. NDA's 102 of 126 was in Assam.

new.s: V.D. Satheesan, sworn in as Kerala Chief Minister on 18 May 2026, belongs to the:
new.x: Satheesan is from the Congress (UDF); the UDF ended 10 years of LDF rule in Kerala.

new.s: Which party's Chief Minister, C. Joseph Vijay, formed the government in Tamil Nadu in May 2026?
new.x: C. Joseph Vijay of the TVK was sworn in on 10 May 2026, ending the ~60-year DMK-AIADMK duopoly.

new.s: Besides Suvendu Adhikari in West Bengal, who is noted as the first BJP Chief Minister of his State?
new.x: Samrat Choudhary (Bihar) and Suvendu Adhikari (West Bengal) are the first BJP CMs of their States.

new.s: In the 2026 West Bengal Assembly election, the BJP won how many of the 294 seats?
new.x: The BJP won 208 seats and the Trinamool 80; Mamata Banerjee lost Bhabanipur, ending her 15 years as CM.

new.s: During the 2026 Assembly polls, which Governor held additional charge of Tamil Nadu?
new.x: Kerala Governor Rajendra Arlekar held additional charge of Tamil Nadu from 12 March 2026; R.N. Ravi moved to West Bengal.

new.s: In the 12 October 2026 reshuffle, who was named Governor of Kerala (Keralam)?
new.x: Om Prakash Mathur, earlier Sikkim Governor, became Kerala's Governor; Arlekar was made full-time Governor of Tamil Nadu.

new.s: Who was the Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry at the time of the 2026 Assembly polls?
new.x: K. Kailashnathan was the LG of Puducherry; Lakshman Prasad Acharya was Governor of Assam.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (Governor - State, 12 October 2026 reshuffle) is correctly matched?
new.x: Braj Mohan Ram went to Odisha. Sudha Yadav went to Karnataka, Dushyant Gautam to Sikkim and Dhal Singh Bisen to Uttarakhand.

new.s: Under the ECI's 2026 poll measures, what was introduced at counting centres from 4 May 2026?
new.x: QR-code ID cards were used at counting centres from 4 May 2026; colour photographs were put on EVMs.

new.s: Census 2027 is India's ____ census overall.
new.x: Census 2027 is the 16th census overall and the 8th after Independence, coming 16 years after 2011.

new.s: Census 2027 comes after a gap of how many years since the previous census?
new.x: The last census was in 2011; the 2021 Census was postponed due to COVID-19, so the gap is 16 years, not 12.

new.s: In Census 2027, in which phase is the caste of individuals recorded?
new.x: Caste is counted in Phase II (February 2027) with population and socio-economic data; Phase I covers house listing.

new.s: The self-enumeration portal of Census 2027 is available in how many languages?
new.x: The online self-enumeration portal works in 16 languages, and households get a Self-Enumeration ID.

new.s: The legal basis for recording every individual's caste in Census 2027 is:
new.x: Caste enumeration rests on Section 3 of the Census Act, 1948, not the Census Rules, 1990.

new.s: In which year was the first census of India held?
new.x: The first census was held in 1872; the first complete census in 1881 and the first after Independence in 1951.

new.s: India's population according to Census 2011, the last census, was:
new.x: Census 2011 recorded 121.08 crore people.

new.s: Which group showed the highest growth in LFPR (15+) in the 'Women and Men in India 2025' report?
new.x: LFPR of rural women rose from 37.5% (2022) to 45.9% (2025), the highest growth among groups.

new.s: How many Bills were passed by both Houses in the Monsoon Session 2026 of Parliament?
new.x: 12 Bills were introduced and 11 passed by both Houses in the Monsoon Session (20 July - 13 August 2026).

new.s: Which Bill remained pending at the end of Parliament's Monsoon Session 2026?
new.x: The Indian Statistical Institute Bill, 2026 was pending; the Kerala renaming Bill passed both Houses in August 2026.

new.s: The Monsoon Session 2026 of Parliament was adjourned sine die on:
new.x: The session ran from 20 July to 13 August 2026, when it was adjourned sine die.

new.s: The 20 November 2025 opinion on Governors' assent to State Bills was given on a Presidential Reference under:
new.x: A five-judge Bench gave an advisory opinion on a Reference under Article 143; Articles 200 and 201 concern assent by Governor and President.

new.s: The five-judge Constitution Bench that answered the 2025 Presidential Reference on Governors' assent was led by:
new.x: The Bench led by CJI B.R. Gavai held that courts cannot fix timelines for the Governor or the President and that there is no deemed assent.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Supreme Court's 20 November 2025 opinion on Governors' assent?
o: It upheld 'deemed assent' when a Governor delays a Bill.
Courts cannot fix timelines for the Governor under Article 200.
It was an advisory opinion under Article 143.
It followed the April 2025 Tamil Nadu ruling on timelines.
new.x: The Court held there is no 'deemed assent'; the April 2025 Tamil Nadu ruling had set timelines and deemed assent.

new.s: After the 2026 Act, the sanctioned strength of Supreme Court judges excluding the CJI is:
new.x: The Act raised the number from 33 to 37 judges excluding the CJI, i.e. 38 including the CJI.

new.s: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Ordinance, 2026 was promulgated on:
new.x: It was promulgated on 16 May 2026 under Article 123; the replacement Act got assent on 11 August 2026 with effect from 16 May 2026.

new.s: What is the outlay of eCourts Phase III, approved by the Union Cabinet on 13 September 2023?
new.x: eCourts Phase III is a 4-year Central Sector Scheme of ₹7,210 crore with 1,150 virtual courts and 4,400 eSewa Kendras.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: eCourts Phase III - Centrally Sponsored Scheme
new.x: The Fast Track Special Courts scheme is Centrally Sponsored (₹1,952.23 crore, Nirbhaya Fund); eCourts Phase III is a Central Sector Scheme of ₹7,210 crore.

new.s: How many virtual courts are included in eCourts Phase III?
new.x: eCourts Phase III includes 1,150 virtual courts and 4,400 eSewa Kendras.

new.s: Who became Executive Chairman of NALSA from 24 November 2025?
new.x: Justice Vikram Nath succeeded Justice Surya Kant, who became CJI; J.K. Maheshwari chairs the SC Legal Services Committee.

new.s: The NALSA Veer Parivar Sahayata Yojana, 2025 provides legal aid to:
new.x: Launched on 26 July 2025 at Srinagar, it gives legal aid to families of soldiers.

new.s: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Bill passed in 2026 introduces:
o: A pre-packaged process for MSMEs only
A new Insolvency Board replacing the NCLT
new.x: It brings a creditor-initiated insolvency resolution process, started out of court, to cut the NCLT backlog.

new.s: The Bills of Lading Act, 2025 repealed the Indian Bills of Lading Act of:
new.x: The Bills of Lading Act, 2025 (assent 24 July 2025) repealed the Indian Bills of Lading Act, 1856.

new.s: Which pair (new Act - old law repealed) is correctly matched?
o: Bills of Lading Act, 2025 - Merchant Shipping Act, 1958
Merchant Shipping Act, 2025 - Indian Bills of Lading Act, 1856
Merchant Shipping Act, 2025 - Merchant Shipping Act, 1958
Bills of Lading Act, 2025 - Indian Bills of Lading Act, 1891
new.x: The Merchant Shipping Act, 2025 replaced the 1958 Act; the Bills of Lading Act, 2025 replaced the 1856 Act.

new.s: Kerala was renamed 'Keralam' by Parliament in August 2026 under which Article?
new.x: Renaming a State is a simple-majority law under Article 3 amending the First Schedule, not an Article 368 amendment.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026:
1. It amends the First Schedule of the Constitution.
2. It is a constitutional amendment under Article 368.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only 1 is correct: made under Article 3, it amends the First Schedule as an ordinary law, not an Article 368 amendment.

new.s: The Constitution (130th Amendment) Bill, 2025 provides for removal of a PM, CM or Minister held in custody for:
new.x: The Bill covers custody for 30 consecutive days on a charge punishable with 5 years or more; it amends Articles 75, 164 and 239AA.

new.s: Which Articles does the Constitution (130th Amendment) Bill, 2025 amend?
new.x: The Bill amends Articles 75, 164 and 239AA; it was sent to a Joint Parliamentary Committee.

new.s: Mission Investigation@75 Days, requiring charge-sheets within 75 days of the FIR, was launched by:
new.x: Bihar Police runs Mission Investigation@75 Days from 1 January 2024; the Shakti app is Andhra Pradesh's.

new.s: Under e-Zero FIR, cyber financial fraud above what amount reported on 1930 becomes an FIR automatically?
new.x: e-Zero FIR (MHA/I4C, May 2025, Delhi pilot) converts cyber financial fraud complaints above ₹10 lakh into FIRs.

new.s: Which Constitution Amendment Bill was defeated in the Lok Sabha on 17 April 2026?
new.x: The 131st Bill failed to get two-thirds of members present and voting; 129th is ONOE and 130th is removal after 30 days' custody.

new.s: The defeated 131st Amendment Bill (2026) proposed to raise Lok Sabha seats from 543 to:
new.x: It proposed 850 seats (815 States + 35 UTs) to bring forward the 33% women's reservation via delimitation on the 2011 Census.

new.s: The 106th Constitutional Amendment on women's reservation in legislatures inserted which Article?
new.x: The 106th Amendment (women's reservation) inserted Article 334A; Article 82A is proposed by the 129th (ONOE) Bill.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 131st Constitution Amendment Bill, 2026?
o: It was passed by the Lok Sabha but defeated in the Rajya Sabha.
It sought to bring forward 33% women's reservation.
It used the 2011 Census for delimitation.
It failed to get a two-thirds majority of members present and voting.
new.x: The Bill was defeated in the Lok Sabha on 17 April 2026, the first NDA amendment Bill to fail there in 12 years.

new.s: Haryana's 75% local reservation in private-sector jobs was struck down by:
new.x: The Punjab and Haryana High Court, not the Supreme Court, struck down Haryana's 75% domicile quota in private jobs.

new.s: The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Act, 2026 replaced:
o: The Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007
new.x: The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment), 2026 replaced an Income-tax Ordinance; the 1961 Act was replaced by the Income Tax Act, 2025.

new.s: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 received Presidential assent in:
new.x: The IBC got Presidential assent on 28 May 2016.

new.s: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 replaced:
new.x: BNSS replaced the CrPC, 1973; BNS replaced the IPC, 1860 and BSA the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.

new.s: Which pair (new law - law replaced) is correctly matched?
o: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 - Indian Evidence Act, 1872
new.x: BSA replaced the Evidence Act, 1872; BNS replaced the IPC, 1860 and BNSS the CrPC, 1973.

new.s: The Income Tax Act, 2025 came into force on:
new.x: The Income Tax Act, 2025, replacing the Income-tax Act, 1961, is in force from 1 April 2026.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Human Organ Transplantation Ordinance (June 2026) was promulgated under:
new.x: Governors promulgate ordinances under Article 213; Article 123 is the President's ordinance power.

new.s: The Supreme Court upheld the ECI's Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls on:
new.x: The SIR verdict came on 27 May 2026; SIR itself began in Bihar under the order of 24 June 2025.

new.s: In the SIR verdict, the ECI's power to revise rolls was traced to the RP Act, 1950 and:
new.x: The Court relied on Article 324 and the Representation of the People Act, 1950, and said the ECI cannot determine citizenship.

new.s: Which case struck down talaq-e-biddat (instant triple talaq) in 2017?
o: Benazeer Heena v. Union of India
S. Rajaseekaran v. Union of India
new.x: Shayara Bano (2017) struck down instant triple talaq; Benazeer Heena (Talaq-e-Hasan) is still pending.

new.s: Legislative privileges under Article 194(3) are before a Supreme Court Bench of how many judges?
new.x: Privileges (Art. 194(3)) - 7 judges; Governor's assent reference - 5; meaning of 'industry' - 9.

new.s: In April 2026, the Supreme Court stayed which of the following?
new.x: The Supreme Court stayed the UGC equity regulations, 2026 in April 2026; it upheld the SIR in May 2026.

new.s: Progress of court complexes in Andhra Pradesh is tracked on which portal?
new.x: AP's court complexes (10 done, 24 under way) are tracked on the Nyaya Vikas portal.

new.s: How many new Division Benches did the Supreme Court set up in July 2026?
new.x: The Supreme Court set up four new Division Benches in July 2026.

new.s: Bihar's e-voting app 'e-Voting SECBHR' was developed by:
new.x: The Android app e-Voting SECBHR was built by C-DAC and uses blockchain and face-matching.

new.s: Which technologies does Bihar's 'e-Voting SECBHR' app use?
new.x: The C-DAC app for urban local body polls (June 2025) uses blockchain plus face-matching.

new.s: Which pair (old name - new name) is correctly matched?
o: Jonnagiri Gold Mine - Global Engagement Mine
Scheme for Promotion of International Cultural Relations - Swarnagiri Scheme
new.x: Nauru became the Republic of Naoero (Aug 2026); Jonnagiri became Swarnagiri; the cultural scheme became the Global Engagement Scheme.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Shakti app, launched on 8 March 2025, sends SOS alerts to the nearest police station and:
new.x: The Shakti app sends an SOS with live location to the nearest police station and 112.

new.s: Which pair (initiative - launched by) is correctly matched?
new.x: Shakti app = Andhra Pradesh; Mission Investigation@75 Days = Bihar Police; e-Zero FIR = MHA/I4C with a Delhi pilot.

new.s: The e-Zero FIR initiative of MHA/I4C (May 2025) was first piloted in:
new.x: e-Zero FIR was piloted in Delhi; it auto-registers FIRs for cyber fraud above ₹10 lakh.

new.s: The repo-rate hike of 7 October 2026 was the RBI's first since:
new.x: The 25 bps hike (5.25% to 5.50%) was the first since February 2023, after the cuts of 2025.

new.s: How many members does the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee have?
new.x: The MPC has 6 members - 3 from RBI and 3 from the Centre - and the Governor has the casting vote.

new.s: Under Section 45ZN of the RBI Act, failure to meet the inflation target means CPI outside the band for:
new.x: Section 45ZN failure is 3 consecutive quarters outside the 2-6% band, not 3 months.

new.s: Which pair (RBI Act section - subject) is correctly matched?
new.x: 45ZA sets the CPI 4% ± 2% target, 45ZB creates the MPC and 45ZN defines failure.

new.s: The new CPI series released on 12 February 2026 has which base year?
new.x: The new CPI uses base 2024 (from 2012), 12 COICOP 2018 groups and HCES 2023-24 weights; GDP's base is 2022-23.

new.s: India's CPI inflation in September 2026 was:
new.x: CPI inflation was 5.54% in Sep 2026, the highest since 6.25% (Oct 2024); it was 4.45% in July and 4.8% in August.

new.s: Which State recorded the highest CPI inflation among those cited for September 2026?
new.x: Uttar Pradesh had the highest CPI at 6.81%; Telangana slipped to 4th and Andhra Pradesh was at 6.29%.

new.s: Which agency forecast India's FY 2026-27 growth at 7.1%, raising it from 6.6%?
new.x: 7.1% is the World Bank's forecast; IMF 7.0%; SBI Research and DBS 7.3%.

new.s: In October 2026, Fitch BMI raised India's FY2026-27 growth forecast from 6.8% to:
new.x: Fitch BMI raised it from 6.8% to 7.5% and cut FY2027-28 from 6.5% to 6.3%.

new.s: India's gross GST collection in September 2026 was about:
new.x: Gross GST in Sep 2026 was ₹2,03,521 crore (+14.7%); ₹2.31 lakh crore is October's gross and ₹1.76 lakh crore September's net.

new.s: In GST Council voting, the weight of the Centre's vote is:
new.x: The Centre has one-third and the States two-thirds of the weighted votes; decisions need three-fourths.

new.s: GST came into force in India on:
new.x: GST came into force on 1 July 2017 under the 101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016.

new.s: Which was the first country to accept India's UPI?
new.x: Bhutan was the first; Uzbekistan became the 11th country to accept UPI on 1 September 2026.

new.s: RuPay was launched by NPCI in which year?
new.x: NPCI launched RuPay in 2012; NPCI was set up in 2008 and UPI came in 2016.

new.s: NPCI's fast-payment platform asked about in APPSC papers is:
new.x: NPCI's fast-payment platform is called 'Vajra' (asked in 2018).

new.s: NPCI was promoted by the RBI and:
new.x: NPCI's promoters are the RBI and the Indian Banks' Association; it took over NFS from IDRBT Hyderabad in 2009.

new.s: The withdrawal of ₹2,000 notes on 19 May 2023 was announced by:
new.x: The RBI announced the ₹2,000 withdrawal and the note remains legal tender; demonetisation (2016) was announced by the PM.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about demonetisation (8 November 2016)?
o: The deposit window ran till 30 December 2016.
It was announced by the RBI Governor.
It was notified under the RBI Act, 1934.
new.x: Demonetisation was announced by PM Narendra Modi in a televised address, not by the RBI Governor.

new.s: By 30 April 2026, what share of the withdrawn ₹2,000 notes had returned?
